ops.title: Phase 1 complete: proc/trust/worker/peer/codeidentity rebuilt to internal/proc + internal/trust + root Run
ops.body:
Phase-1 implementation is DONE and on main (all per-package internal/... green; whole-module CI +
fleet-build red by design until phase 3). Four commits, each built -> adversarially refuted ->
(adjudicated/fixed where needed) -> independently verified -> shipped:
- P1a c87f8a3: advisory file lock -> internal/flock (12 exported symbols removed; sentinels aliased).
- P1b f36f2d58: proc (12,716 lines) -> internal/proc (~1,900). One unexported identity + single
  matches site; suspended spawn (record fsynced before SIGCONT); single-writer store on
  internal/state; closure-local driver; reap ladder. Refuter found 8 real defects (unbounded
  Run/driver deadline hangs, dup2 handoff-clobber, archived-core durability holes, terminate-vs-exit
  signal race) -- all fixed red-before-green, each a permanent regression test.
- P1c 9c2016b2: trust/peer/codeidentity -> internal/trust (kernel-only, T0+T1). Seven csops
  reads; T1 reads CS_OPS_BLOB, finds the CD by SHA-256==CS_OPS_CDHASH, resolves the signing leaf via
  CMS SignerInfo (defeats the decoy-cert attack), asserts leaf OU == CD team == req.TeamID. Apple's
  CMS is BER not DER -> a bounded fuzzed envelope walker (all security decisions in stdlib x509/asn1).
  Refuter CLEAN; independently re-verified (10M+ fuzz execs zero crashers, deny corpus, code review).
- P1d 8d2e5af6: worker (1,934) -> root Run wrapper over internal/proc.Store.Run. Fixed 3 engine
  invariants in internal/proc the P1b pass had missed (EPIPE-vs-genuine stdin failure per os/exec
  semantics; terminate-on-output-cap; Path/Dir validation). The build correctly checked back on a
  spec-vs-code contradiction; the refuter caught an EPIPE over-fix -- both resolved.

Export census: 1272 -> 899 exported symbols (the rename ledger, ci/exported.txt, regenerated each
ship). G1 resolved (kernel-only proven safe via the forgery PoC, note d9b94fb); DER grammar measured
(e731b1e); trust design T0+T1 (275d06d).

P1e was SUBSUMED (note 0592653): "one comparison site" is achieved by internal/proc's sole matches;
peer/peer.go's site vanished with peer's deletion (P1c); daemon/child_fence.go + service/stop_runtime.go
are broken-and-pending-rewrite in P2/P3 packages that delegate to internal/proc then.

STILL OPEN (future turns): G4 signed-peer CI (deferred to phase 3, task fbcace8); phase 2 (internal/wire
+ Swift mirror, incl. the live accept-loop DoS fix + daemon runtime-auth rewrite); phase 3 (assembly:
root Serve, launchd converge, deploy; restores whole-module compile + fleet-build green); phase 4 flag
day (consumer repins). The daemon claim-plumbing full strip lands with phase-3's trust-verifier cut.
